repos.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
repos.description: The web data API to search, scrape, and interact at scale. 🔥
repos.one_liner: A robust web scraping API designed to convert entire websites into LLM-ready markdown data at scale.
bullets: Built with TypeScript and Node.js, utilizing a distributed architecture for scalable crawling.
Provides a unified API to extract clean, structured data from complex web pages for RAG pipelines.
Essential for fintech and quant researchers needing real-time market data or news aggregation.
Supports advanced features like crawl maps, custom scraping instructions, and proxy rotation.

repos.name: dream-num/univer
repos.description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, open-source office suite designed as a programmable runtime for AI agents.
bullets: TypeScript-based modular architecture supporting spreadsheets, docs, slides, and relational tables.
Designed to act as a headless or UI-integrated 'Office Harness' for agentic workflows.
Enables AI agents to perform complex data analysis, financial modeling, and document generation.
Provides a unified data model that allows agents to manipulate multiple document types programmatically.

repos.name: graykode/abtop
repos.description: Like htop, but for AI coding agents. Monitor Claude    Code & Codex CLI sessions, tokens, context window,    rate limits, and ports in real-time.
repos.one_liner: A real-time monitoring tool for AI coding agents, functioning like htop for agentic sessions.
bullets: Written in Rust for high performance and low-overhead system monitoring.
Tracks critical metrics including token usage, context window consumption, and rate limits.
Provides visibility into active coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex) to optimize costs and performance.
Essential infrastructure for developers managing large-scale agentic deployments.

repos.name: HarnessRouter/harnessrouter
repos.description: HarnessRouter Community Edition: the self-hosted, Apache-2.0 edition of the unified interface for agent harnesses. Run Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, and more through one API, with sessions, streaming, files, cancellation, and failure handling. Implements the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP), an open standard. Your keys, your infrastructure.
repos.one_liner: A self-hosted, unified interface and API gateway for managing various AI coding agent harnesses.
bullets: Python-based community edition providing a standardized API for disparate agent tools.
Supports session management, streaming, and unified logging across multiple agent frameworks.
Enables enterprise-grade control and observability over agentic coding workflows.
Facilitates easier integration of diverse agents into existing CI/CD and development infrastructure.
repos.img2_alt: Adding a model provider in HarnessRouter

repos.name: ai-evals-course/evals-skills
repos.description: Skills for building LLM evals. Starts with interactive error discovery: build a review app, sample diverse traces, and organize human annotations into failure modes.
repos.one_liner: A practical curriculum and toolkit for building robust evaluation pipelines for LLM applications.
bullets: Focuses on interactive error discovery, trace sampling, and human-in-the-loop annotation.
Provides a structured methodology for identifying failure modes in complex agentic systems.
Essential for fintech and high-stakes AI applications where accuracy and reliability are paramount.
Includes templates for building review apps to systematically validate agent outputs.
